Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). ⛔ WHY THIS SPEC EXISTS AT ALL — integration-test-revert-verify §A7: adding a branch beside an existing guard can retire that guard's coverage silently, and the new axes cannot see it because they are about a different source. The obvious-looking fix for this ticket was to add CREATE_INSTANCE to the type-gate; the sibling suite already asserts the OPPOSITE (a non-property_set grounding carrying a stray `targetValue*` must NOT be refused, and its list names CREATE_INSTANCE), so that fix would have reddened it. The requirement therefore introduced an INDEPENDENT function reading the declared schema instead, and this spec is the machine-checked statement that the old gate is still alive: removing it must redden the sibling suite. The sibling file is not edited by this change — its 16 tests pass unmodified, which is the other half of the same proof.
